definitions.explanation: Medicine that can be purchased without a prescription at pharmacies and drugstores.

examples.japanese: {市販薬|しはんやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I'll see how it goes with over-the-counter medicine.

examples.japanese: {市販薬|しはんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧⟦{効|き}かない→効く：01932_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I took OTC medicine but it's not working.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧なら{市販薬|しはんやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: For mild symptoms, you can manage with over-the-counter medicine.

notes:
{市販薬|しはんやく} (also called OTC{医薬品|いやくひん}) is available at drugstores and pharmacies without a prescription. In Japan, they are classified into categories with different sales restrictions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市販薬|しはんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy OTC medicine)
- {市販薬|しはんやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{治|なお}す→治す：19371_naosu⟧ (to cure with OTC medicine)
- {市販薬|しはんやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風邪薬|かぜぐすり}→風邪薬：09712_kazegusuri⟧ (OTC cold medicine)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{処方薬|しょほうやく}→処方薬：18860_shohouyaku⟧: prescription medicine
- ⟦ドラッグストア→ドラッグストア：09710_doraggusutoa⟧: drugstore
- ⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧: pharmacy
- {第一類|だいいちるい}⟦{医薬品|いやくひん}→医薬品：19711_iyakuhin⟧: first-class OTC drugs (pharmacist consultation required)
